chunk_findings.detail: The change claims home/XDG/ZDOTDIR are read through the Env adapter, but `target_file` still resolves any `~` in `home`, `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, or `ZDOTDIR` via `Path.expanduser()`, which reads the process environment (`HOME`/`pwd`), not the injected `env`. For example, with `env=FakeEnv({"HOME": "/fake", "XDG_CONFIG_HOME": "[REDACTED:path]"})` while the process has `HOME=/real`, `target_file("fish", "/unused", env=env)` returns `/real/.config/fish/config.fish` instead of `/fake/.config/fish/config.fish`; with `ZDOTDIR="[REDACTED:path]"` it likewise returns the real user's `[REDACTED:path]`. Thus a fake/overridden adapter cannot isolate completion installation, and the code can still touch the real home directory when tilde-containing environment values are present.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/services/completion/install.py:target_file

chunk_findings.detail: Tilde expansion still goes through `Path.expanduser()` (process `os.environ` / `pwd`), not the new `env` adapter, and `_home()` makes that worse by returning a bare `"~"` when the adapter has no `HOME`. Given an injected env with `HOME` unset and `ZDOTDIR="[REDACTED:path]"`, while the process has `HOME=/real/user`, `_home()` yields `"~"` and `target_file("zsh", "~", env=...)` resolves to `/real/user/.zshrc` or `/real/user/dotfiles/.zshrc` instead of staying inside the adapter. The fallback path and `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`/`ZDOTDIR` are therefore not actually read only through `Env`, so a stubbed environment still edits the real user's startup file.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/services/completion/install.py:target_file

chunk_findings.detail: Tilde expansion still goes through `Path.expanduser()` (process `os.environ` / `pwd`), not the new `env` adapter, and `_home()` makes that worse by returning a bare `"~"` when the adapter has no `HOME`. chunk_findings.title: ddflow/services/completion/install.py:target_file

chunk_findings.detail: The no-HOME fallback still resolves `~` from the process environment, so the earlier no-HOME leak remains. Given a process environment with `HOME=/real/user` and an injected adapter such as `env=_Env({"ZDOTDIR": "[REDACTED:path]"})` (HOME unset), `target_file("zsh", "~", env)` calls `_expand("~", env)`; because `env.get("HOME")` is `None`, it falls through to `Path("~").expanduser()` and returns `/real/user`. It then expands `[REDACTED:path]` the same way, producing `/real/user/dotfiles/.zshrc` instead of a path derived only from the injected environment. The added test only covers the case where the injected env has `HOME`, so the previously confirmed HOME-unset leak is not fixed.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/services/completion/install.py:_expand

chunk_findings.detail: The confirmed HOME-unset case is still resolved from the process, not the injected env. `_expand` only substitutes `env.get("HOME")` when that value is truthy and the path is `~` or `[REDACTED:path]`; otherwise it still calls `Path(text).expanduser()`, which reads process `HOME`/`pwd`. Given an injected env with `HOME` unset and `ZDOTDIR="[REDACTED:path]"` while the process has `HOME=/real/user`, `target_file("zsh", "~", env)` returns `/real/user/dotfiles/.zshrc` (and the `home` argument `"~"` itself becomes `/real/user`). The new test only sets injected `HOME` to `/fake`, so it does not cover this probe, and the docstring’s process fallback is the same defect, not a fix.

chunk_findings.detail: `_expand` still falls back to `Path(text).expanduser()` whenever the injected env has no truthy `HOME`, so `target_file` can resolve `~` from the process environment instead of staying inside the adapter. For example, with `monkeypatch.setenv("HOME", "/real")` and an injected env equivalent to `_Env({"ZDOTDIR": "[REDACTED:path]"})` (no `HOME`), `target_file("zsh", "~", env)` calls `_expand("~", env)` with `home=None`, returns `Path("~").expanduser()` -> `/real`, then `_expand("[REDACTED:path]", env)` -> `/real/zdot`, yielding `/real/zdot/.zshrc`. The new test only passes because its fake env supplies `HOME`; the no-HOME case remains process-environment leakage, so the previous confirmed concern is not fully answered.

chunk_findings.detail: The confirmed HOME-unset probe is not fixed. `_expand` only substitutes `env["HOME"]` when that value is truthy and the path is exactly `~` or `[REDACTED:path]`; otherwise it still calls `Path.expanduser()`, which reads the process `HOME`/`pwd`. With an injected env that has `HOME` unset and `ZDOTDIR="[REDACTED:path]"` (or `target_file("zsh", "~", env)` when `_home()` still yields `"~"`) while the process has `HOME=/real/user`, line 28 returns `/real/user/dotfiles/.zshrc` or `/real/user/.zshrc` instead of staying inside the adapter. The new test only sets `HOME=/fake`, so it never hits this branch; the docstring even keeps the process fallback the earlier finding rejected.

data.probe: deliberate, documented fallback: an Env with no HOME has no home to give, so the account's own home (pwd) is the only answer, exactly what the shell does and what os.path.expanduser did before. chunk_findings.detail: The change claims home/XDG/ZDOTDIR are read through the Env adapter, but `target_file` still resolves any `~` in `home`, `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, or `ZDOTDIR` via `Path.expanduser()`, which reads the process environment (`HOME`/`pwd`), not the injected `env`. For example, with `env=FakeEnv({"HOME": "/fake", "XDG_CONFIG_HOME": "[REDACTED:path]"})` while the process has `HOME=/real`, `target_file("fish", "/unused", env=env)` returns `/real/.config/fish/config.fish` instead of `/fake/.config/fish/config.fish`; with `ZDOTDIR="[REDACTED:path]"` it likewise returns the real user's `[REDACTED:path]`. Thus a fake/overridden adapter cannot isolate completion installation, and the code can still touch the real home directory when tilde-containing environment values are present.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/services/completion/install.py:target_file

chunk_findings.detail: Tilde expansion still goes through `Path.expanduser()` (process `os.environ` / `pwd`), not the new `env` adapter, and `_home()` makes that worse by returning a bare `"~"` when the adapter has no `HOME`. Given an injected env with `HOME` unset and `ZDOTDIR="[REDACTED:path]"`, while the process has `HOME=/real/user`, `_home()` yields `"~"` and `target_file("zsh", "~", env=...)` resolves to `/real/user/.zshrc` or `/real/user/dotfiles/.zshrc` instead of staying inside the adapter. The fallback path and `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`/`ZDOTDIR` are therefore not actually read only through `Env`, so a stubbed environment still edits the real user's startup file.

chunk_findings.detail: `_expand` still falls back to `Path(text).expanduser()` whenever the injected env has no truthy `HOME`, so `target_file` can resolve `~` from the process environment instead of staying inside the adapter.
